blocks.text: Referrals today are a guessing game

Emails, spreadsheets and follow-ups. Nobody is sure who owns a candidate, or who is owed. Who referred this person? Was the same candidate referred twice? Has the client replied? Is my bonus coming? BeeRef answers all four from one record.
Everything referrals, built around your people
One record for every job, referral and reward. Recruiters, managers, employees and finance all work from the same place.

items.title: Careers page
items.body: Publish open roles with the reward shown on each (for example, Java Lead, ₹50,000 reward). Every share becomes a tracked link, so you can see who shared what and how many clicks it earned.

items.title: Referral chains
items.body: Chains of up to three people, with one fair owner per candidate. Duplicate referrals are caught at source, and the owner is settled by your rule, not by argument.

items.title: AI screening
items.body: Applicants are read and ranked against the role so recruiters start with a shortlist. The final decision is always left to people.

items.title: Client stages and probation tracking
items.body: Every interview round in one view (applied, shortlisted, client round 2, hired), then probation tracked day by day so rewards are paid at the right time.

items.title: Rewards and wallet
items.body: Rewards accrue to a wallet, with withdrawal to bank and a payroll export, so finance pays exactly what is owed, when it is owed.

items.title: Insights
items.body: Open jobs, referrals, candidates in probation, rewards due and hires by source (boards, careers page, invites, referrals) on one dashboard.

blocks.text: BeeRef prepares the work. People make every decision.

items.title: You ask
items.body: Type what you need in plain words, for example "Pay Meera's referral reward". BeeRef finds the right referral, hire and rule.

items.title: BeeRef prepares
items.body: It checks ownership, probation and your reward rules, then drafts the payout: candidate, referrer, days completed, amount, with Hold or Approve.

items.title: You decide
items.body: Nothing is paid until you approve. Then everyone is updated at once: reward approved, referrer notified, wallet credited, payroll export updated.

items.title: Each role sees only its part
items.body: Recruiters see the pipeline and the rules. Managers see their roles and rounds. Employees see their referrals, probation status and wallet. Finance sees what is due and what was approved, and by whom.

items.title: You confirm first

items.title: Clear status, linked to the source
items.body: Referred, shortlisted, hired, in probation, paid: always visible to the referrer, and every reward points back to its referral, its rule and the person who approved it.

items.a: BeeRef runs referral hiring from the first share to the final reward: careers page, tracked referral links, ownership checks, AI screening, client hiring stages and wallet payouts in one workspace.
Partner companies, recruiters and TA teams, hiring managers, employees and referrers, and finance teams. Each role sees only its own part of the process.

items.q: What if two people refer the same candidate?
items.a: Referral chains allow up to three people, but BeeRef assigns one fair owner per candidate according to your rule, and flags duplicates at the moment of referral.
When the hire completes probation under your reward rules. BeeRef tracks the probation period, drafts the payout and waits for your approval before the wallet is credited.

items.q: Can Purview run referral hiring for us?
items.a: Yes. Workforce Solutions can run BeeRef alongside RabbiT voice screening, Volume Recruitment and Contract Payroll as one managed hiring service.
